description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, comparing their performance over time. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250,000, marked at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents loss, also on a linear scale, spanning from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. Two lines are shown: one in purple with triangle markers and a solid line style, representing an unspecified model, and another in red with circular markers and a solid line style, representing SepLLM. Both lines exhibit a decreasing trend in loss as training time increases, starting at approximately 2.73 and 2.72 for the purple and red lines, respectively, at 0 seconds, and ending at around 2.47 and 2.45 at 250,000 seconds. The purple line begins at a higher loss value and remains above the red line throughout the training time, with the red line (SepLLM) showing a slightly steeper decline.
